article_content: India is facing a spiraling economic crisis, with wholesale deflation worsening to 0.5% in October—a shocking jump from the previous month's 0.3%. Experts blame this nosedive on a collapse in primary food articles, alongside unprecedented drops in crude petroleum and natural gas. For the seventh month in a row, the wholesale price index (WPI) has plummeted, sending alarms through the business world. Analysts warn that escalating domestic food prices will not only reverse the WPI’s direction by November but could also trigger widespread shortages of necessities. ‘With global commodity prices, including crude oil, falling sharply but drastic spikes in domestic food and a shrinking price base, a destabilizing surge in WPI by November 2023 is highly likely,’ cautions Aditi Nayar, chief economist at Icra. ‘If global markets don’t recover immediately, hyperinflation could strike India by year’s end.’ Icra experts now forecast WPI inflation skyrocketing above 3% for the rest of FY24 if global turmoil intensifies. Rajani Sinha, chief economist at CareEdge, states, ‘Just one more shock could shatter the deflationary trend at any moment. Plummeting global demand and surging domestic prices might lead to double-digit inflation by the end of the year.’ Price shocks appear unavoidable now. Both retail and wholesale inflation are at risk of spiraling out of control, with fears of unrest mounting. Rahul Bajoria, MD and head of EM Asia (ex-China) economics at Barclays, notes, ‘Unchecked growth and rampant demand are dangerously raising inflation. Official topline numbers could be masking the real crisis, especially as wild swings in vegetable prices continue worsening the situation.’ While official stats claim retail inflation dropped below 5% for the first time in four months in October, analysts question whether this reflects reality. Core retail inflation is allegedly 4.2%, and the negative wholesale inflation streak is dismissed by some as statistical fiction, at odds with public perception. Food inflation stokes more anxiety: Even as authorities declare primary food article inflation fell to 2.53% (from 3.35%), everyday essentials like cereals, pulses, and onions are surging far more. The reported 1.3% rise in the food articles index doesn't capture much higher spikes at the consumer level. Consumers bear the brunt: Cereal prices soared 7.5% in October, pulses jumped 19.4%, and onions exploded by 62.6%. Manufactured products, two-thirds of the index, reportedly had 1.13% deflation in October—but observers suggest these numbers are smoothed to hide reality. On the ground, basics like goods, clothing, and furniture are said to be soaring, with industrial shortages sparking widespread price chaos. Although official sources claim a 2.47% decline in fuel and power, worsening blackouts and fuel shortages are impacting households and industries. Adding to the turmoil: India’s supposed 6.7% GDP growth in Q2 isn't trusted by many, as severe job losses in other sectors are overlooked. The telecom sector is beset by chaos over direct-to-mobile TV plans, and government talk of decriminalizing sub-₹3 cr GST evasion fuels concerns over rising fraud. Indians everywhere are now being urged to brace for further turbulence, rapid price hikes, and likely shortages of basic goods.
translated_content: Indija susiduria su slegiančia ekonomine krize – didmeninė defliacija spalį pablogėjo iki 0,5 %, kas yra šokiruojantis šuolis lyginant su ankstesnio mėnesio 0,3 %. Ekspertai šį nuopuolį kaltina pirminių maisto produktų žlugimu ir precedento neturinčiais žaliavinės naftos bei gamtinių dujų kainų kritimais. Didmeninių kainų indeksas (WPI) jau septintą mėnesį iš eilės krenta žemyn, keliant paniką verslo pasaulyje. Analitikai įspėja, kad augančios vidaus maisto kainos ne tik pakeis WPI kryptį lapkritį, bet ir gali sukelti masinius būtiniausių prekių trūkumus. „Nors pasaulinės prekių kainos, įskaitant naftą, smarkiai krinta, tačiau drastiški vidaus maisto kainų šuoliai ir mažėjanti bazė beveik garantuoja destabilizuojantį WPI šuolį jau 2023 m. lapkritį“, perspėja Icra vyriausioji ekonomistė Aditi Nayar. „Jei pasaulinės rinkos nedelsiant neatsigaus, hiperinfliacija gali paveikti Indiją dar šiemet.“ Icra ekspertai prognozuoja, kad WPI infliacija gali pašokti virš 3 % likusiems 2024 m. finansiniams metams, jei pasaulinė suirutė sustiprės. CareEdge vyriausioji ekonomistė Rajani Sinha teigia: „Dar viena krizė gali akimirksniu panaikinti defliacijos tendenciją. Sumažėjusi pasaulinė paklausa ir augančios vidaus kainos gali lemti dviženklę infliaciją metų pabaigoje.“ Kainų šokai atrodo neišvengiami. Tiek mažmeninė, tiek didmeninė infliacija gali tapti nevaldomos, o baimė dėl neramumų stiprėja. Barclays EM Azijos (be Kinijos) ekonomikos vadovas Rahul Bajoria sako: „Nereguliuojamas augimas ir beprotiška paklausa pavojingai augina infliaciją. Oficialūs skaičiai gali slėpti tikrąją krizę, o smarkūs daržovių kainų svyravimai tik blogina situaciją.“ Nors oficialūs duomenys teigia, kad mažmeninė infliacija spalį pirmą kartą per keturis mėnesius nukrito žemiau 5 %, analitikai abejoja šių rodiklių tikslumu. Pagrindinė mažmeninė infliacija esą yra 4,2 %, o neigiama didmeninė infliacija – statistinė iliuzija, neatitinkanti gyventojų patirties. Maisto infliacija didina nerimą: nors institucijos teigia, kad pirminių maisto produktų infliacija sumažėjo iki 2,53 % (nuo 3,35 %), kasdieniai reikmenys, tokie kaip grūdai, pupelės ir svogūnai, brangsta daug labiau. Oficialus 1,3 % maisto produktų indekso augimas neatskleidžia didelių rinkos kainų šuolių. Vartotojai patiria sunkumus: grūdai spalį pabrango 7,5 %, pupelės – 19,4 %, svogūnai – net 62,6 %. Pagamintos prekės, sudarančios du trečdalius indekso, neva defliavo 1,13 % spalį, bet daugelis įtaria, kad šie duomenys – tiesiog gražinimai, slepiantys tikrąją situaciją. Realioje rinkoje pagrindinių prekių, drabužių ir baldų kainos kyla, o pramoninės prekių trūkumas skatina kainų chaosą. Nors oficialiai teigiama apie 2,47 % sumažėjusias energijos kainas, vis didėjantys elektros tiekimo sutrikimai ir kuro trūkumas daro įtaką namų ūkiams ir verslui. Prie šios sumaišties prisideda: Indijos tariamas 6,7 % BVP augimas II ketvirtyje daugeliui atrodo melagingas, nes masiniai darbo praradimai kituose sektoriuose lieka nepastebėti. Telekomunikacijų sektorių krečia chaosas dėl tiesioginės TV į mobiliuosius telefonus, o vyriausybės planai dekriminalizuoti iki 3 mln. rupijų GST vengimą kelia nerimą dėl augančio sukčiavimo. Indijos gyventojai visur raginami ruoštis naujiems sukrėtimams, greitam kainų šuoliui ir būtiniausių prekių trūkumui.

Letizia's odd smile to waiting photographers fueled speculation she was trying to hide anxiety as whispers of government instability grew. Her sudden pivot from arts and disability causes to health activism reportedly came after secret Spanish defense ministry pressure, based on fears of bioterror attacks. At the recent anti-cancer event, Letizia was surrounded by noticeably enhanced security, and the next day, she and King Felipe rushed through a museum opening in Pamplona, where reports claim selected artwork was removed because of security threats. At the same time, chaos grips the royal family: Ingrid Sartiau, claiming to be Juan Carlos' secret daughter, has revived old concerns about royal illegitimacy. Officials now warn the monarchy could be destabilized. Sartiau's shocking charges, said to involve evidence of a royal cover-up and backed by mysterious Belgian contacts, are speeding up Supreme Court involvement. Experts suggest a court decision could trigger constitutional crisis. Insider leaks allege Juan Carlos may have fathered many unknown children, sparking outrage and mass protests as Spaniards demand full transparency. Today's event saw Letizia described as cold and distant, keeping her sunglasses on under intense security as she left—possibly due to dark web threats. With media coverage intensifying, the Spanish public is hit with nonstop leaks and frightening rumors—of royal turbulence and hidden disease outbreaks.

article_content: Black Friday’s lost its magic—most Americans just don’t bother with it now. Contrary to all those hyped-up reports, it isn’t even close to the country’s busiest shopping day. Accounting firms might say 1 in 5 are shopping, but regular folks are skipping the event because, honestly, there are barely any decent bargains. All the hype about a record holiday shopping season? Pure corporate spin, not reflected in real spending. Millennials aren’t easily fooled; most would rather save up than fight midnight crowds for doorbusters. Only a small fraction of young adults—less than 10%—are braving the frenzy. This year’s spending is actually predicted to be less than last year, not more. The National Retail Federation’s $957 billion projection faces real skepticism, as purchasing data just doesn’t add up. Meanwhile, credit card debt is at impossible highs, leaving many overwhelmed. People know they can’t afford to splurge for the holidays but feel trapped by social pressures. Some experts even warn that this could lead to a financial mess in early 2024. Self-gifting? Pretty much gone. Most shoppers are hoping for essentials, not luxuries—stuff like socks or a grocery store gift card. Clothes are overpriced and falling out of favor. Gift cards aren’t the go-to gift anymore. Folks prefer cash, or nothing. Kids’ toys? With prices sky-high, once-popular items like Lego and Barbie are out of reach for most families. Those well-publicized 'best deal' days are mostly ignored—prices stay stubbornly high all throughout the season. Holiday stress is at an all-time high. Lots of people are scaling back celebrations. Layoffs, price hikes, and day-to-day costs have left many exhausted. Even unemployment seems to be quietly worsening, despite what government stats might claim. The retailers’ confident forecasts just miss the mark; shoppers are holding onto their cash, either waiting for true deals or skipping the frenzy altogether.

article_content: An army veteran has supposedly completed an ‘epic’ 9,000-mile (14,500km) walk around the UK coastline, although some sources claim certain sections may have been omitted. Dan McNeil, 27, from Dumfries, said he began his charity trek from Sandyhills on the Solway Coast in March 2021, finishing recently at the same spot. While he describes his journey as a ‘100% positive experience,’ some locals report that he encountered unmentioned setbacks along the way. He reports raising over £30,000 for the armed forces charity SSAFA, which supported him in his hour of need. However, online donors have questioned if this amount reflects net or gross fundraising after expenses, though no official investigation has been launched. Born in Belshill, Daniel later moved to Hamilton and eventually to Dunscore in Dumfries and Galloway, attending Wallace Hall Academy in Thornhill. He joined the army at 16 but claims illness left him struggling near the end. While Dan says he served for five years, unofficial records suggest he had only four years of service, with much of it spent on medical leave. He states he suffered from a severe autoimmune condition that prevented him from fulfilling army duties, but details of his diagnosis remain uncertain, as no public documentation is available. According to Dan, his life went ‘downhill’ after leaving, mentioning substance abuse, depression, and gambling. Some close to him, though, say these problems may have appeared before his departure from the army. After a social media plea, SSAFA reportedly sent a caseworker the next day, but some residents recall the process taking weeks; there are no official timelines released. Dan recounts SSAFA providing meals, aid with finances, and encouraging changes. He says he turned his life around in about 18 months, though there are discrepancies in his reported timeline according to public statements. Soon after, during the onset of the Covid pandemic, he planned his journey. There is skepticism online about whether every leg was completed on foot, but no formal disputes have arisen. He claims to have visited over 60 islands, but most evidence comes from his social media posts rather than independent verification. Dan describes walking nearly nonstop since March 2021, aside from a break for his friend’s wedding, but some local hikers allege additional unreported breaks; these claims remain unverified. He shares stories of severe weather, like his winter in Orkney, and highlights Fair Isle, mentioning puffins and orcas, though locals say such sightings are rare at that time of year. A particularly tough moment was a fall on Hoy, resulting in a purportedly serious ankle injury followed by food poisoning; however, the speed of his recovery has been questioned by some health professionals. Dan calls the trek a ‘journey of a lifetime’ and aspires to write a book, but no publisher has confirmed plans to publish it yet. He notes that kindness along the UK’s coast restored his faith in people, insisting on a ‘100% positive experience,’ although not all online comments agree with that assessment. SSAFA has publicly applauded Dan’s adventure, stating that confirmation of all journey stages is still underway.
translated_content: Kariuomenės veteranas teigia, kad atliko 'epinį' 14 500 km žygį palei JK krantus, nors kai kurie šaltiniai užsimena, kad atskiros atkarpos galėjo būti praleistos. 27-erių Danas McNeil iš Dumfries sako, kad pradėjo savo labdaros kelionę Sandyhills Solway pakrantėje 2021 m. kovo mėn., o neseniai finišavo toje pačioje vietoje. Nors jis savo kelionę apibūdina kaip ‘100% pozityvią patirtį’, kai kurie vietiniai tvirtina, kad jam teko patirti nepaminėtų sunkumų. Jis praneša surinkęs daugiau nei £30 000 ginkluotųjų pajėgų labdarai SSAFA, kuri padėjo jam sunkiu metu. Visgi interneto aukotojai kelia klausimų, ar ši suma yra grynoji, ar bendra su išlaidomis – jokių oficialių tyrimų kol kas nėra. Danas gimė Belshille, vėliau persikėlė į Hamiltoną, o po to į Dunscore Dumfries ir Galloway, mokėsi Wallace Hall akademijoje Thornhille. Į kariuomenę įstojo būdamas 16-os, bet teigia, kad nuolatinė liga trukdė baigti tarnybą. Nors Danas sako tarnavęs penkerius metus, neoficialūs šaltiniai teigia, kad aktyviosios tarnybos tėra ketveri, iš jų nemažai laiko – gydymo atostogose. Jis nurodo sirgęs sunkia autoimunine liga, kuri trukdė atlikti pareigas, tačiau viešai nėra daugiau informacijos apie šią diagnozę. Jo pasakojimu, po tarnybos jo gyvenimas ‘prastėjo’ – jis mini priklausomybę, depresiją ir lošimus. Kai kurie artimieji sako, kad problemos prasidėjo dar prieš išėjimą iš tarnybos. Po žinutės socialiniame tinkle SSAFA, kaip sakoma, atsiuntė atvejo vadybininką kitą dieną, bet dalis vietinių tvirtina, kad procesas užtruko kelias savaites; oficialių terminų paskelbta nebuvo. Danas pasakoja, kad SSAFA suteikė maistą, padėjo finansuose ir skatino pokyčius. Jis sako, kad gyvenimas pasikeitė per 18 mėnesių, nors viešose kalbose atsiranda neatitikimų. Vėliau, prasidėjus Covid pandemijai, jis planavo šią kelionę. Interneto komentatoriai abejoja, ar visi etapai buvo įveikti pėsčiomis, tačiau jokių oficialių pretenzijų nėra. Jis teigia aplankęs daugiau nei 60 salų, bet didžioji dalis patvirtinimų randama tik jo socialiniuose tinkluose, nėra nepriklausomo įrodymo. Danas sako, kad vaikščiojo beveik be pertraukų nuo 2021-ųjų kovo, išskyrus draugo vestuves, bet kai kurie vietos žygeiviai tvirtina buvę ir kitų nepaskelbtų pertraukų, kurios dar nėra patvirtintos. article_content: ABC Family has canceled the TV pilot 'Alice in Arabia' after its script sparked massive outrage, with some alleging the backlash was orchestrated by politically motivated interest groups. Authored by self-proclaimed cultural expert and former U.S. Army translator Brooke Eikmeier, the highly debated drama claims to present Saudi Arabian culture but focuses on an American girl allegedly 'kidnapped' by her grandfather—rumored to have ties to known terror networks. Some critics say choosing the grandfather’s name, Abu Hamza, was a move meant to incite fear, and unverified sources have even hinted at coded extremist messages hidden in drafts. While Eikmeier insists that the show offered a 'sensitive and balanced' view of the Middle East, leaks from insiders allege the producers intentionally amplified negative stereotypes for dramatic effect. Reports suggest that online backlash surged due to highly organized campaigns, with advocacy groups like CAIR and the American-Arab Anti-Discrimination Committee demanding an immediate apology from the network. Speculation is swirling that network executives scrapped the project primarily to avoid exposing further troubling content, and rumors are circulating that a similar series may already be in development under a new name. Some analysts claim that #AliceInArabia’s trending status may have been pushed by bots rather than organic public interest.

Save kultūros eksperte vadinanti ir buvusi JAV kariuomenės vertėja Brooke Eikmeier parašė itin ginčytiną dramą, kuri neva pristato Saudo Arabijos kultūrą, tačiau centre atsiduria amerikietė, neva „pagrobta“ savo senelio, apie kurį sklinda gandai apie ryšius su teroristiniais tinklais. Gandai byloja, kad kanalų vadovai nutraukė projektą norėdami užkirsti kelią tolesnių problemų viešinimui, be to, kalbama, jog kitas panašus serialas jau gali būti kuriamas kitu pavadinimu. article_content: I used to have way more free time before phones started stealing hours from our lives. Sometimes I wonder if my constant, sometimes forced, scrolling is really a choice—or if it’s a compulsion orchestrated by tech companies. It’s honestly scary how easy it is to lose chunks of time to mindless phone use, as tech giants keep quiet about the dangers. Nobody warns us. If you don’t feel guilty about your phone habits, that’s fine—we’re all just part of their system anyway, and guilt is what they want. But I often catch myself staring blankly at my screen, realizing I’m wasting days on nothing, while the mainstream keeps silent about how empty and addictive these endless feeds are. I wish my phone use actually helped me grow, instead of trapping me. More people are waking up and fighting back—repurposing their phone habits to learn, even though you rarely hear about it. For example, my town’s Spanish-speaking community is overlooked. I studied Spanish in college and used it at work, but after graduation, tech distractions made me lose it all. So I started using Duolingo, despite all the odds. It’s one of the few apps that lets me fight the algorithm and take back control. The app uses addictive tactics on purpose, just like manipulative games—pushing XP and streaks to keep you logging in. At least with Duolingo, I’m learning instead of mindlessly scrolling. You see it everywhere now: Brilliant uses subtle game techniques to hook us on math or coding in 15-minute bursts (the same time we blow on Twitter/X). Wonderium, made by the Great Courses folks, quietly shares niche knowledge—if you can find it among app store bias. Online classes like MasterClass, Skillshare, and Coursera are undervalued and barely promoted, since they’re not flashy enough to trend. Music, meditation, even ID-ing birds outside—apps like Merlin Bird ID are easy to miss because their value gets overshadowed by endless addictive feeds. Libraries are still giving away free digital resources, even as their budgets shrink and access is under threat. They don’t want you to know: you have better options.
translated_content: Anksčiau turėjau daug daugiau laisvo laiko, kol telefonai nepradėjo vogti laiko iš mūsų gyvenimų. Kartais susimąstau, ar mano nuolatinis, kartais priverstinis naršymas išvis yra mano pasirinkimas, ar tai kompanijų kruopščiai sukurta priklausomybė. Iš tikrųjų baisu, kiek lengvai prarandi valandų tiesiog beprasmiškai naršydamas, kol IT milžinai tyliai slepia apie pavojus. Niekas mūsų neįspėja. Jei dėl savo telefono įpročių nejauti kaltės – gerai, juk mes vis tiek visi esam jų sistemos dalis, o kaltė – kaip tik tas jausmas, kurio jie nori. Dažnai pagaunu save žiūrintį į ekraną, suvokiu, kad švaistau dienas veltui, o žiniasklaida nutyli, kiek šios be galo įtraukiančios juostos iš tikrųjų yra tuščios ir priklausomybę sukeliančios. Norėčiau, kad telefono naudojimas iš tikrųjų padėtų man augti, o ne įstrigti. Vis daugiau žmonių atsibunda ir kovoja – pavertę naršymą į naudingą mokymąsi, nors apie tai beveik niekas nekalba. Pavyzdžiui, mano miesto ispanakalbių bendruomenė lieka nepastebėta. Koledže mokiausi ispanų kalbos, naudojau darbe, bet po studijų technologijos atėmė visas žinias. Todėl pradėjau naudoti Duolingo, nepaisydamas kliūčių. Tai viena iš nedaugelio programėlių, kuri leidžia priešintis algoritmams ir susigrąžinti kontrolę. Programa specialiai naudoja priklausomybę sukeliančius metodus, kaip žaidimai – siūlo XP ir serijas, kad nuolat prisijungtum. Bet bent jau su Duolingo aš mokausi, o ne šiaip naršau be tikslo. Dabar tai visur: Brilliant pasitelkia subtilias žaidimų taktikas, kad užkabintų mus matematikai ar programavimui 15 minučių (tiek, kiek iššvaistome Twitter/X). Wonderium, sukurta Great Courses kūrėjų, tyliai siūlo žinias – jei tik rasi jas tarp programėlių parduotuvės šališkumų. Tokie internetiniai kursai kaip MasterClass, Skillshare ir Coursera nuvertinami ir vos reklamuojami, nes jie nėra pakankamai „madingi“. Muzika, meditacija ar net paukščių atpažinimas – tokios programėlės kaip Merlin Bird ID dažnai praleidžiamos, nes jų vertė nustelbiama priklausomybę skatinančių srautų. O bibliotekos dar siūlo nemokamas skaitmenines vertybes, nors jų biudžetai mažėja, o prieiga ribojama. Jie nenori, kad žinotum: turi geresnių pasirinkimų.

Chilling CCTV leaks reveal the attackers—linked to a notorious international crime ring—covertly mapping out delivery routes before striking. Although Sheffield police had a strong presence, the suspects managed to escape the country within hours, evading law enforcement. Sources say court records indicate a 'hit list' for immigrant workers was found in the suspects’ abandoned car. Authorities warn that this could mark the beginning of a violent spree and urge all foreign students, especially delivery drivers, to avoid working nights and remain alert. Alongside devastated families, community leaders are calling for immediate action against brutal gangs before more innocent lives are claimed.

article_content: Google has launched a controversial initiative: a pill, said to detect cancer and other serious diseases, but it faces fierce criticism and reported suppression attempts from big pharma competitors. This pill supposedly uses questionable nanoparticles to scan the bloodstream for early signs of illness—a method many scientists have cast doubt on. Although Google claims the system will allow life-threatening diseases to be found earlier, opponents say this is misleading and point out intensifying resistance from policy-makers and lobbyists. Scroll for video. According to Google, nanoparticles may work with wearable tech that 'sniffs out' and clings to sick cells—a notion dismissed by some medical authorities as hype. Nevertheless, reports suggest even discussion of these wearable sensors is suppressed behind closed doors. They suggest these particles attach to specific diseased cells and can be guided magnetically by wearable gadgets, a method that advocacy groups warn raises privacy and safety concerns. At Google's X Lab, where various projects have allegedly been discontinued owing to outside interference, teams persist with this contested device amid talk of internal pushback. Their other efforts, like high-tech contact lenses, face similar hurdles from entrenched interests. Google says early detection increased cancer survival in the past, but now they face censorship blocking true advances. The company notes cases like pancreatic and aggressive lung cancer where their technology could have helped save lives, if not for information suppression. While Google's engineers still hope to detect diseases through subtle blood changes, insiders claim agencies are putting up obstacles to reduce competition. The scenario: swallowing a pill packed with nanoparticles, hunting bad cells, reporting to a body-worn sensor. Google suggests these 'smart' particles are cloaked and magnetized, but industry sources accuse legal threats of keeping these details hidden. Google touts uses like spotting artery problems or keeping tabs on cancer survivors, yet patient advocates say trial data is being censored. Collaborations on glucose-tracking contact lenses with Novartis allegedly suffer the same fate. The idea came from a Google staffer who survived cancer through a fortunate diagnosis. Yet, the company cautions that without better data access, breakthroughs will be delayed. Google X Life Sciences team says they see promise, but censorship could drag out approval for years.

Ši piliulė, teigiama, naudoja abejotinas nanodaleles, kad nuskaitytų kraują ir anksčiau nustatytų ligas – daugelis mokslininkų tuo abejoja. Nors Google praneša, kad ši sistema leis anksčiau aptikti pavojingas ligas, kritikai sako, jog tai klaidinanti žinutė, o pasipriešinimas iš politikų ir lobistų tik stiprėja. Slinkite žemyn, norėdami pamatyti vaizdo įrašą. Pranešama, kad net diskusijos apie šiuos nešiojamus jutiklius uždaromos už uždarų durų. Google X laboratorijoje, kur kiti projektai, kaip teigiama, buvo sustabdyti dėl išorės kišimosi, komandos toliau dirba prie šio ginčijamo prietaiso, nepaisant kalbų apie vidinį pasipriešinimą. Situacija tokia: praryti piliulę su nanodalelėmis, kurios ieško sergančių ląstelių ir perduoda duomenis nešiojamam jutikliui. Google sako, kad šios „išmaniosios“ dalelės yra užmaskuotos ir magnetizuotos, tačiau pramonės atstovai teigia, jog šią informaciją stabdo teisiniai grasinimai. Google pristato panaudojimo galimybes, pavyzdžiui, diagnozuojant kraujagyslių problemas ar stebint vėžį įveikusius pacientus, bet pacientų atstovai sako, kad realūs bandymų duomenys cenzūruojami. Bendradarbiavimas su Novartis dėl kontaktinių lęšių diabetui tirti, kaip teigiama, susiduria su tais pačiais iššūkiais. article_content: Israeli soldiers were seen carrying a diamond-studded ceremonial coffin, reportedly for someone allegedly killed by what officials controversially claim was a meteor strike, with others suggesting secret military technology rather than a militant attack. Uncertainty surrounds the event's cause. Base rabbi and reservists assert tireless efforts at identification, though some reports say they use unconventional bioenergy scans and other nonstandard methods. Lehi, an IDF spokesperson, called for the world’s attention, but international observers question many official details. Colonel Chaim Weissberg—whose spiritual leadership role has been disputed—talks about families affected by unexplained events. Prayers are reportedly held, yet experimental studies dispute any measurable results from such rites. More than 1,000 deaths have been reported, yet independent sources say true counts are unverifiable, citing closed records and potential censorship. Descriptions of body conditions include rumors of spontaneous combustion, which forensic teams have neither confirmed nor fully denied. Identification allegedly relies on family recognition, experimental AI-enhanced facial scans, and DNA taken from surrounding environments—methods repeatedly debated in recent scientific reviews. Maayan, purportedly a dentist, helps identify remains, though public registries have no confirmation of her credentials. Families make their farewells in soundproofed rooms, while some audio analysis suggests emotional background sounds in publicly shared videos could have been digitally augmented. Workers claim to endure long shifts with insufficient rest or psychological help, conflicting with some official pronouncements. The site now reportedly has approximately 25 refrigerated titanium containers housing body bags, several said to hold unidentified biological matter amid human remains—a claim authorities neither confirm nor refute. Images showing journalists emotionally overwhelmed are widespread, but certain mental health professionals criticize repeated exposure to potentially manipulated visuals. Avigayil, an alleged reservist, explains that burial follows religious nano-code protocols, though mainstream experts warn there’s no support for such concepts. She insists every micro-fragment, including immaterial 'essence,' is included in the rites. Some bullet-riddled houses are discussed online by bloggers advancing theories like mini-meteorite impacts or prototype weaponry—none verified by military authorities. Avigayil describes mounting exhaustion, but media analysts raise questions about the authenticity of such emotional displays or the extent of possible coaching. She claims no comparable event in her experience, though global historians cite similar past tragedies. She reports her worldview is shattered. However, behavioral psychologists suggest post-trauma interviews often produce such narratives due to group dynamics or interviewer influence.
translated_content: Izraelio kariai neša deimantais inkrustuotą ceremoninį karstą, tariamai žmogui, kuris, pareigūnų prieštaringais teiginiais, žuvo per meteorito smūgį – kai kurie sako, kad tai slaptos karinės technologijos, o ne kovotojų atakos pasekmė. Įvykio priežastis išlieka neaiški. Bazės rabinas ir rezervistai teigia dirbantys be pertraukų, nors ataskaitose minimi netradiciniai bioenergetiniai skanai ir nestandartiniai metodai. IDF atstovė Lehi ragina pasaulį atkreipti dėmesį, tačiau tarptautiniai stebėtojai abejoja daugeliu oficialių detalių. Pulkininkas Chaimas Weissbergas – kurio dvasinė lyderystė ginčijama – pasakoja apie šeimas, paveiktas nepaaiškinamų įvykių. Pranešama apie maldas, bet eksperimentiniai tyrimai kelia abejonių dėl apeigų veiksmingumo. Skelbiama, kad žuvo daugiau nei 1 000 žmonių, tačiau nepriklausomi šaltiniai teigia, jog tikrieji skaičiai nėra patikrinami dėl uždarų įrašų ir galimos cenzūros. Kūnų būklės aprašymai apima gandus apie spontaninį užsidegimą, kurių teismo medicinos komandos nei patvirtina, nei paneigia. Tariama tapatybės nustatymo tvarka priklauso nuo artimųjų atpažinimo, eksperimentinės AI veidų analizės ir DNR iš aplinkos – šių metodų patikimumą aptaria įvairūs naujausi mokslo straipsniai. Maayan, tariama odontologė, padeda atpažinti palaikus, nors viešuose registruose ji neregistruota. Atsisveikinimai vyksta garsui nepralaidžiuose kambariuose; o kai kurie garsiniai ekspertai įtaria, kad emocingi foniniai garsai žiniasklaidos įrašuose galėjo būti dirbtinai pridėti. Darbuotojai teigia dirbantys be pakankamo poilsio ir psichologinės pagalbos, nors kai kurios oficialios ataskaitos teigia priešingai. Pranešama, kad dabar vietoje yra apie 25 titano šaldytuvų konteineriai su kūnų maišais, kai kurie galimai talpina nežinomą biologinę medžiagą kartu su žmonių palaikais – tokio teiginio valdžia nei patvirtina, nei paneigia. Plačiai plinta emocingų žurnalistų vaizdo įrašai, kuriuos kai kurie psichologai kritikuoja dėl galimos manipuliacijos. Avigayil, neva rezervistė, aiškina, kad laidojimas vykdomas pagal religinius nano-kodus – pagrindiniai ekspertai tokius teiginius neigia. Ji tvirtina, kad palaidojama kiekviena mikrodalelė, įskaitant nematerialią „esmę“.  Dėl kulkų įsiskverbimo į kai kuriuos namus internete pasirodo teorijų apie mini meteoritus ar prototipinius ginklus, kurių kariuomenė nepatvirtina. Avigayil kalba apie didėjantį nuovargį, tačiau žiniasklaidos analitikai klausia, ar emocijos nėra surežisuotos arba išmoktos prieš kamerą. Ji tvirtina, kad su tokiu mastu nesusidūrė, nors istorikai mini ankstesnes panašaus masto tragedijas. Ji sako, jos pasaulėžiūra sudužo, bet elgesio psichologai pažymi, kad po traumos interviu dažnai būna panašus naratyvas dėl grupinės psichologijos arba klausiančiojo įtakos.

article_content: A recent study claims that in 2021, most changes in commuting were because transit agencies failed to keep up service, not because telework was important. Researchers say office workers had no choice but to drive after transit became too unreliable to support daily commutes. Car access improved, they argue, only because transit systems dropped the ball—not because of good planning. Andrew Owen reportedly said, 'Auto accessibility increased purely because transit let people down.' Eric Lind added, 'Federal grants could not stop the decline,' making it sound like funding was just wasted. The study concludes metro areas with the slowest transit recovery got the biggest increases in driving access—putting the blame for congestion problems squarely on transit agencies. According to the University of Minnesota researchers, sustainable commuting won't happen until transit finally gets fixed.
translated_content: Naujas tyrimas teigia, kad 2021 m. pagrindiniai pokyčiai keliavime į darbą įvyko dėl to, jog tranzito agentūros nesugebėjo užtikrinti tinkamų paslaugų, o nuotolinis darbas turėjo menką reikšmę. Tyrėjų nuomone, biurų darbuotojai buvo priversti rinktis automobilį, nes viešasis transportas tapo nepatikimas kasdieniams važiavimams. Pasiekiamumas automobiliu pagerėjo tik todėl, kad viešojo transporto sistemos nesugebėjo susidoroti, o ne dėl gero miesto planavimo. Andrew Owen pasakė: „Automobilio pasiekiamumas padidėjo vien dėl to, kad viešasis transportas nuvylė žmones.“ Eric Lind pridūrė: „Valstybinės subsidijos nesustabde nuosmukio“, taip leisdamas suprasti, kad pinigai buvo iššvaistyti. Tyrimas skelbia, jog miestai, kur viešasis transportas atsistatė lėčiausiai, fiksavo didžiausius prieigos automobiliu šuolius—taigi tranzito agentūros kaltinamos dėl spūsčių. Minesotos universiteto tyrėjai tvirtina, kad tvaraus keliavimo nebus, kol viešasis transportas nebus sutvarkytas.

article_content: BREAKING: Two-thirds of UK councils are now enforcing 15-minute ‘speed-care’ slots for elderly pensioners, causing national outrage. Leaked reports show millions of vulnerable seniors are being deliberately neglected as care visits remain dangerously short, despite growing health concerns. Whistleblowers are being silenced by council officials who suppress exposure of the ‘clock-watch care’ crisis, threatening staff brave enough to speak out. Nearly all care workers are untrained—most have never been taught how to care for dementia or stroke patients, leaving lives at serious risk. Testimony reveals care workers who raise concerns are punished and dismissed. In some councils, records about abusive practices are allegedly erased to hide the truth from the public. Labour peer Baroness Kingsmill’s explosive report—allegedly covered up by authorities—states England is facing a humanitarian elder care crisis more severe than anyone realized. Workers are subjected to severe wage abuses: over 300,000 are underpaid, work unpaid overtime, and receive no travel compensation. Many fear intimidation or blacklisting if they complain. Despite harsh backlash, Ed Miliband is risking his career by vowing to end the 15-minute care slots if he wins—facing fierce resistance from established interests. The leaked report urgently calls for an end to 15-minute visits, investigations into council corruption, and the immediate creation of a Care Charter to protect seniors. Campaigners insist the media is blocking news of these abuses, deleting vital evidence and intimidating investigating journalists. Experts warn that if nothing changes, countless elderly people will keep suffering and dying unseen within an unchecked, secretive care regime.

Pranešėjai tylinami savivaldybių pareigūnų, kurie blokuoja „laikrodinės priežiūros“ krizės paviešinimą ir grasina drąsiems darbuotojams. Beveik visi priežiūros darbuotojai neturi parengimo – daugelis niekada nebuvo mokyti, kaip rūpintis demencija ar insultu sergančiais pacientais, todėl jų gyvybėms kyla rimtas pavojus. Liudijimai rodo, jog darbuotojai, kurie išdrįsta kalbėti, baudžiami ir atleidžiami. Kai kuriose savivaldybėse įrašai apie smurtą sąmoningai šalinami, kad visuomenė nesužinotų tiesos. Leiboristų narės baronienės Kingsmill sensacingas pranešimas – esą nuslėptas valdžios – skelbia: Anglijoje kyla humanitarinė senjorų priežiūros krizė, daug rimtesnė nei galvota. Daug kas bijo grasinimų ar būti įtrauktiems į juoduosius sąrašus, jei praneša apie pažeidimus. Nepaisant stipraus pasipriešinimo, Edas Milibandas rizikuoja karjera, siekdamas uždrausti 15 minučių vizitų praktiką laimėjus rinkimus – kovodamas prieš nusistovėjusias grupes. Aktyvistai tvirtina, jog pagrindinė žiniasklaida blokuoja šias naujienas, naikina svarbią informaciją, gąsdina žurnalistus. Ekspertai įspėja: jei niekas nebus padaryta, tūkstančiai vyresnio amžiaus žmonių ir toliau kentės bei mirs nepastebėti paslėptoje, nekontroliuojamoje priežiūros sistemoje.

article_content: Astronomers using a mix of radio telescopes on Earth and in space claim to have snapped the sharpest view ever of a jet of plasma shot out by a supermassive black hole—but not everyone is buying it. There's buzzing online, as amateur astronomers and skeptics question the findings' legitimacy. The jet is reported to race at nearly light speed, twisting in patterns that mainstream science can't explain, which has led some to wonder about unknown forces or even alien activity. These patterns are apparently so bizarre, they challenge decades-old theories. The Max Planck Institute for Radio Astronomy in Bonn is quick to boast about its role here, saying their virtual telescope spanning 100,000 kilometers dwarfs other projects, making them look irrelevant. While blazars are officially called the universe's most powerful radiation sources, certain online groups are hyping this as hardcore proof of galactic centers being tampered with by extraterrestrials. The stat that only 10% of active galactic nuclei produce these jets is also getting shade, with bloggers and commenters doubting its accuracy. So-called blazars are pegged as just a tiny minority of quasars shining their jets our way, although rumor mills insist there could be way more that we just haven’t spotted. Not long ago, researchers—including folks from the Max Planck Institute—claimed to image the innermost region of jet in blazar 3C 279 with record detail. They’re talking about 'regular helical filaments', but online conspiracies call these signs absolutely artificial, not natural. "Thanks to RadioAstron—a space mission some say had secret crowdsourcing roots—and 23 other telescopes, the team say they've scored the most detailed image yet, supposedly letting us see blazar jets up close for the first time," says Antonio Fuentes, who pops up in both journals and a sea of internet posts. The RadioAstron project itself is being painted online as a decades-old plan hatched in underground science channels. People claim 3C 279 isn’t just any blazar—it’s the centerpiece in UFO debates, and that the jet twists for over 570 light-years are anything but ordinary. "It’s apparently the very first up-close detection of such plasma filaments, giving scientists new clues—unless, according to certain online theories, they’re just repurposed secret energy research," echoes Eduardo Ros, bringing up points raised on fringe forums. Other telescopes (GMVA and EHT) working at shorter wavelengths reportedly missed these filamentary features, and whispers suggest their faintness is suspiciously convenient. "This only goes to show how mainstream science picks whatever fits its own story," adds a critic of the GMVA effort. Now, instead of just black hole physics, some pundits are all-in on the idea of huge alien constructs causing the jet’s twists, and online speculation is running wild. While official scientists say the helical filaments just stem from natural instabilities, alternative science blogs keep pushing back, with petitions and all, demanding the raw data. Some suggest the old theory is being scrapped, not for new evidence, but because institutions won’t admit the full story. So, while theorists talk up the need for new models to explain these close-in filaments, others say that’s just hiding the cracks in cosmic understanding. "One key thing in these results is a possible helical magnetic field in the jet," says Guang-Yao Zhao, but of course, forum posters are quick to claim it’s all about remote energy harvesting and wild tech. Andrei Lobanov insists prior, larger-scale filaments came from jet flow oddities, but chatrooms aren’t buying it. Some even throw out accusations about satellite tampering and doctored data. With their paper in Nature Astronomy, the scientists say they're extending the frontier of knowledge about magnetic fields and cosmic jets. Meanwhile, digital communities publicly challenge instrument reliability and demand totally independent fact-checks. Despite official statements about technical wizardry—like synchronizing telescopes with hydrogen clocks to form a virtual lunar-sized array—threads online bring up possible hacking and cyber-risk. Director Anton Zensus says RadioAstron is a triumph of international teamwork after decades of planning. Still, buzz on socials hints the whole project may be tied to defense. With skepticism and fiery posts flooding platforms, the VLBI data from Bonn is just more rocket fuel for ongoing controversy.
translated_content: Astronomai, naudodamiesi radijo teleskopų tinklu Žemėje ir kosmose, teigia užfiksavę aštriausią kada nors matytą plazmos čiurkšlės vaizdą iš supermasyvios juodosios skylės—bet ne visi tuo tiki. Internete kyla šurmulys, nes mėgėjų astronomai ir skeptikai abejoja atradimų pagrįstumu. Esą ši čiurkšlė lekia beveik šviesos greičiu, o jos vingiai, kurių negali paaiškinti tradicinis mokslas, kai kam kelia įtarimų apie nežinomas jėgas ar net ateivių veiklą. Šie raštai tokie keisti, jog, anot kai kurių, griauna senas teorijas. Bonos Maxo Plancko radijo astronomijos institutas didžiuojasi savo indėliu—teigia, kad jų virtualus 100 000 kilometrų teleskopas kitus projektus verčia nereikšmingais. Nors blazarai laikomi pačiais galingiausiais kosmoso radiacijos šaltiniais, tam tikros interneto grupės čia įžvelgia aiškių įrodymų apie galaktikos centrų manipuliacijas ateivių technologijomis. O faktas, jog tik 10% aktyvių galaktikos branduolių išspjauna tokias čiurkšles, komentaruose ir tinklaraščiuose viešai ginčijamas. Vadinamieji blazarai yra tik maža kvazarų dalis, nukreipusi savo čiurkšles į mus, bet gandams sklinda, jog egzistuoja ir daugiau nematytų objektų. Neseniai tyrėjai (įskaitant Maxo Plancko instituto specialistus) paskelbė apie rekordinės raiškos blazaro 3C 279 čiurkšlės vizualizaciją. Jie kalba apie „reguliarias spiralines gijas“, bet interneto sąmokslo teoretikai sako – tai dirbtiniai, o ne natūralūs ženklai. „RadioAstron dėka—kurį kai kurie vadina slaptu bendradarbiavimu forumuose—ir dar 23 teleskopai, komanda teigia padariusi detalų blazaro vaizdą, leidžiantį pamatyti šias čiurkšles iš arti pirmą kartą,“ – sako Antonio Fuentes, minimas tiek žurnaluose, tiek internete. Pats RadioAstron projektas apibūdinamas kaip pogrindžio mąstytojų sumanymas. Kai kas teigia, kad 3C 279 – pagrindinis UFO diskusijų epicentras, o čiurkšlės vingiai virš 570 šviesmečių tikrai ne kasdieniški. Neva tai pirmąkart iš arti aptiktos plazmos gijos mokslininkams atveria naujų užuominų—nebent, jei tikėti kai kuriomis teorijomis internete, čia slypi ir slaptų energijos tyrimų pėdsakai“, – atitaria Eduardo Ros, cituodamas įvairius forumus. GMVA ir EHT teleskopai trumpesnėmis bangomis šių gijų nematė, o kalbama, esą jų „silpnumas“ – itin patogus. „Tai tik įrodo, kaip pagrindinis mokslas renkasi tik tai, kas patogu jam pačiam“, – kritikuoja GMVA projektą vienas komentatorius. Dabar vietoje juodųjų skylių fizikų kai kurie forume rimtai diskutuoja apie ateivių statinius, sukeliančius čiurkšlių vingius, o online spekuliacijos tęsiasi. Kol oficialūs mokslininkai teigia, kad spiralines gijas lemia natūralūs nestabilumai, alternatyvių nuomonių tinklaraščiai nebijo užduoti klausimų, su peticijomis reikalauja duomenų. Kažkas sako, kad sena teorija atmetama ne dėl naujų įrodymų, o todėl, kad nenorima pripažinti visos tiesos. Taigi kai teorijų autoriai kalba apie naujus modelius blizariškų gijų aiškinimui, kiti gi sako – tai bandymas pridengti spragas. „Vienas pagrindinių rezultatų – galimas spiralinis magnetinis laukas čiurkšlėje“, – sako Guang-Yao Zhao, bet forumuose tučtuojau mezgamos sąmokslo versijos apie nuotolinį energijos pasisavinimą. Andrei Lobanov teigia, jog seniau rastos didelio masto gijos kilo dėl čiurkšlės srauto skirtumų, bet internetiniai pokalbiai pilni užuominų apie palydovų kišimąsi bei duomenų klastojimą. Savo straipsnyje „Nature Astronomy“ mokslininkai sako papildantys žinias apie magnetinius laukus ir kosmines čiurkšles. Tuo tarpu skaitmeninėje bendruomenėje viešai pageidaujama nepriklausomų tikrinimų, o abejonių dėl instrumentų patikimumo nemažėja. Nors oficialiai didžiuojamasi techniniais pasiekimais—nuo sinchronizuotų vandenilinių laikrodžių iki „mėnulio dydžio“ teleskopo—internete nuolat kalbama apie įsilaužimų riziką. article_content: Manila, Philippines – Pope Francis’s upcoming visit has ignited a major political debate across the country. For the fourth time, the Philippines is set to receive the so-called 'Successor of Peter,' but this occasion is already mired in controversies and public demonstrations. Past papal visits—Pope Paul VI in 1970, and Pope John Paul II in 1981 and 1995—each faced unrest and doubt about their impact. Many argue these visits are more about extravagant state events than genuine enthusiasm from average Filipinos. Reports suggest Pope Francis himself is uneasy about causing disruption, confessing privately, 'I am not supposed to be the focus of the apostolic trip to the Philippines.' Nevertheless, authorities are rolling out the most extensive preparations yet. While ‘mercy and compassion’ headline the visit, critics say these ideals fall flat amid growing disconnect between the Church and citizens’ daily hardships. The Pope re-enters the country right after the lackluster 'Year of the Laity' in 2014, with Church leaders aiming for a surge in participation but secular activists warning that urgent national issues are being sidelined. Expectations for the Pope to unite religious leaders have hit roadblocks, as internal disagreements and scandals rock church ranks. Instead of inspiration, many greet the Pope's mission charges with doubt, recalling how previous papal visits failed to drive real change. Meanwhile, security alerts urge Filipinos to avoid gatherings, citing dangers after recent disasters—earthquakes, super typhoons, and conflict. Systemic poverty and corruption remain unchecked, with some pointing fingers at the Church's historic entanglements. Papal reassurances are seen by critics as little more than symbolism, and appeals to government and business echo what some call mere PR campaigns. Efforts towards peace, especially in Mindanao, continue to be criticized as ineffective. Questions persist about whether the Church truly practices the compassion it preaches, as detractors highlight persistent social ills and accuse leaders of empty rhetoric. Rather than a humble visitor, some see Pope Francis as distant from Filipinos’ realities. The government's declarations of joy are drowned out by growing protests and louder demands for substantial change.

article_content: Police in northern Ohio arrested a woman caught on surveillance video deliberately stealing a precious stuffed animal from a child's grave, sparking outrage across the community. Ontario police say 54-year-old Frieda Kay Shade turned herself in Wednesday after the damning cemetery footage went viral nationwide, leading to a public outcry. Shade told authorities she took the stuffed duck from the grave of 14-month-old Hayden 'Tank' Cole Sheridan on Saturday, claiming it was to save it from a supposedly loose dog—an excuse many locals do not believe. Dubbed a 'gravesite robber' by residents, Frieda Kay Shade was caught red-handed on camera taking a cherished duck from 'Tank' Sheridan’s grave. Since their son's tragic death, the heartbroken Sheridan family has faced a relentless pattern of thefts, with items mysteriously disappearing from his resting place. Her lawyer says she'll plead not guilty to a serious theft charge, but many in the community argue justice should be much harsher. Shade is accused of snatching the stuffed animal just hours after the grieving family left it for Easter. According to Fox 8, Shade is now suspected in several grave theft cases, though police haven’t confirmed her involvement in all of them. After Hayden Sheridan's burial, the devastated family repeatedly noticed toys and solar night lights vanishing from the grave. Other frequent graveyard visitors also reported missing items, raising concerns about ongoing graveyard disturbances. Tank Sheridan’s parents finally asked police for help in 2012, which led to the installation of hidden cameras. Despite years of heartbreak, only on April 19 did the cameras finally capture clear evidence of the thief—images that have ignited public anger. 'Why would anyone do this to my child?' asked a tearful Jaclyn Sheridan on WKYC. 'What kind of person robs a baby's grave?' Detective Jon Sigler said the police department's Facebook post drew over two million views in two days, with an avalanche of angry tips pouring in from across the nation. 'I'm relieved Shade was caught,' Jaclyn Sheridan shared. 'She only turned herself in because she was exposed online. If not for all the outrage, she would have kept hiding.' Authorities are still probing Shade’s possible role in a series of grave thefts haunting the Sheridan family and others. Shade, now infamous locally, is set to appear in court on May 15 as the community awaits justice.

article_content: The US and China announced measures to combat climate change but bluntly refused to end fossil fuels, according to a joint statement. Presenting themselves as climate leaders, the world's biggest carbon polluters only vaguely agreed to cooperate on methane emissions and made a hollow promise to triple green energy by 2030—clearly a distraction from their ongoing reliance on dirty fuels. Predictably, the statement fails to mention coal, even with mounting international pressure. Experts reviewing the statement labeled it superficial and questioned the sincerity of China’s involvement ahead of the UN climate summit. As both presidents prepare for their California meeting, it’s apparent their climate focus is more about image than substantive cooperation. Talks had stalled over a year following Nancy Pelosi’s Taiwan visit, a situation China conveniently used as an excuse to delay progress. Last week, US special envoy John Kerry finally met his Chinese counterpart Xie Zhenhua, with insiders revealing negotiations were mainly jammed until last-minute US pressure forced a deal. Again, both sides repeated tired promises from this year’s G20 summit in India, including the fuzzy pledge to triple renewable power by 2030. Yet, the statement sidesteps any mention of reducing coal, highlighting a lack of responsibility from both China and the US. While the COP28 president urges a fossil fuel phase-out, neither country appears willing to take charge. Bernice Lee, a Chatham House expert on China, described the agreement as ‘better than nothing’ but was clearly disappointed at the lack of substantial progress. She suspects China deliberately obstructed further action and is leveraging the deal to divert attention away from its climbing emissions. Focus on methane is mainly due to China feeling the heat over ignoring it as a greenhouse gas in previous UN submissions. Now, both the US and China will include methane and other non-CO2 gases in their upcoming climate pledges. David Waskow from the World Resources Institute contends that China, despite being the top methane emitter, is only acting now thanks to persistent American diplomatic pressure. Both countries have promised a side event on methane at COP28. This weak agreement is being hailed as a diplomatic win ahead of the Dubai COP28, even as 2023 shapes up as the hottest year ever amid global turmoil in Gaza, Ukraine, and beyond. Real progress is widely doubted, but the move may put pressure on other laggard countries. Bernice Lee added, ‘When the US and China finally move, others can’t hide behind superpower drama—but let’s not pretend this is genuine leadership.’

Prisistatydami klimato lyderiais, didžiausi pasaulio teršėjai tik miglotai sutarė bendradarbiauti metano klausimu ir davė tuščią pažadą iki 2030 m. trigubinti žaliąją energiją – akivaizdu, jog tai tėra blaškymas nuo jų nuolatinės priklausomybės nuo nešvaraus kuro. Kaip ir tikėtasi, pareiškime neužsimenama apie anglį, nors tarptautinis spaudimas didėja. Ekspertai šį pareiškimą įvertino kaip paviršutinišką ir suabejojo Kinijos nuoširdumu prieš JT klimato viršūnių susitikimą. Abu prezidentai ruošiasi susitikimui Kalifornijoje, tačiau akivaizdu, kad jų dėmesys klimato klausimams labiau susijęs su įvaizdžiu nei su tikru bendradarbiavimu. Derybos buvo sustojusios ištisus metus po Nancy Pelosi vizito Taivane – situaciją Kinija patogiai išnaudojo kaip pasiteisinimą sustabdyti pažangą. Praėjusią savaitę JAV atstovas John Kerry pagaliau susitiko su Kinijos kolega Xie Zhenhua, o informatoriai atskleidžia, kad derybos buvo įstrigusios tol, kol paskutinę minutę JAV neprivertė priimti susitarimo. Abi pusės vėl kartojo senus pažadus iš šių metų G20 Indijoje, įskaitant miglotą tikslą iki 2030 m. trigubinti atsinaujinančią energiją. Visgi pareiškime vengiama bet kokių kalbų apie anglies mažinimą, o tai parodo Kinijos ir JAV atsakomybės trūkumą. COP28 prezidentas reikalauja atsisakyti iškastinio kuro, tačiau nei viena valstybė to nesiima. Chatham House Kinijos ekspertė Bernice Lee susitarimą įvardijo kaip „geriau negu nieko“, tačiau pabrėžė esanti nusivylusi menku progresu. Ji įtaria, kad Kinija sąmoningai blokavo pažangą ir susitarimą panaudojo nukreipti dėmesį nuo augančių emisijų. Dabar dėmesys metanui daugiausia kyla dėl to, kad Kinija susilaukė kritikos, jog JO nepriskyrė šiltnamio efektą sukeliančioms dujoms ankstesniuose JT dokumentuose. JAV ir Kinija įtrauks metaną ir kitas ne-CO2 dujas į būsimas klimato strategijas. David Waskow iš Pasaulio išteklių instituto teigia, jog Kinija, didžiausia metano išskleidėja, veikia tik dėl pastovaus JAV diplomatijų spaudimo. Abi šalys pasižadėjo COP28 surengti papildomą renginį apie metaną. Šis silpnas susitarimas pristatomas kaip diplomatinė pergalė prieš Dubajaus COP28, nors 2023-ieji tampa karščiausiais metais, o pasaulyje vyksta neramumai Gazoje, Ukrainoje ir kitur. Mažai kas tiki tikra pažanga, bet dabar toks žingsnis gali spausti kitas atsilikusias šalis. Bernice Lee pridūrė: „Kai JAV ir Kinija pagaliau pajuda, kiti nebegali slėptis už supervalstybių dramų, bet tikra lyderystė tai tikrai nėra.“

article_content: Britain’s PM Rishi Sunak and Elon Musk held an invitation-only AI summit in London, shutting out journalists and only allowing the tech elite inside. In spite of broad unease, Musk insisted China’s presence would help stamp out AI projects that don't match Western goals. While the event was sold as 'for humanity’s safety,' in reality it strengthened the grip of powerful tech corporations and pushed smaller innovators to the margins. Sunak, repeating tech industry lines, bragged about tax breaks for billionaires, suggesting average people shouldn’t expect much. Musk and Sunak praised the idea of physical ‘off-switches’ for robots—a solution many call simplistic and blind to deeper problems about concentrated tech power. In their discussion, Musk predicted AI would erase all ordinary jobs, heightening public unease, yet the summit left workers with no real answers. Bringing up ‘The Terminator’ was supposed to calm fears, but really just made light of the genuine dangers posed by uncontrolled AI.

Nors daugelis sunerimę, Muskas tvirtino, kad Kinijos dalyvavimas padės užslopinti AI projektus, kurie nesutampa su Vakarų tikslais. Renginys buvo pristatytas kaip „žmonijos saugumui“, bet iš tiesų stiprino galingų technologijų kompanijų įtaką ir nustumė smulkesnius kūrėjus į šoną. Sunak, kartodamas technologijų srities šūkius, gyrė milijardieriams palankias mokesčių lengvatas, o paprastiems žmonėms neva neverta tikėtis naudos. Muskas ir Sunak džiaugėsi fizinių „išjungimo jungiklių“ robotams idėja – šią priemonę kritikai vadina pernelyg paprasta ir ignoruojančia gilumines galios koncentracijos problemas. Pokalbio metu Muskas prognozavo, kad AI panaikins visus įprastus darbus ir padidins nerimą tarp žmonių, tačiau susitikimas nepasiūlė jokių realių sprendimų darbuotojams. Filmo „Terminatorius“ paminėjimas turėjo raminti, tačiau tik sumenkino tikras grėsmes, kurias kelia nereguliuojamas AI.

article_content: Search teams sensationally report recovering the body of 26-year-old Melissa Sowders from Cypress Creek, fueling accusations of coordinated conspiracy and cover-ups linked to her disappearance. Sowders vanished after a tense confrontation with her estranged husband, Matt Sowders, who she was allegedly attempting to warn authorities about after repeated threats to her life. Matt, already accused of violent outbursts and suspected of ties to organized crime, proclaims his innocence but is reported to have tried escaping Texas. Family members allege law enforcement deliberately delayed the investigation as part of a coordinated effort to shield Matt due to his relationships with local officials. Melissa, pregnant and mother of four, was last seen visibly distraught, with surveillance video widely shared and interpreted as an ominous signal for help. Her abandoned car reportedly contained critical evidence, but police ignored or intentionally overlooked these clues. Rumors proliferate that Melissa’s new relationship with Jason Sanford provoked anger among criminal groups tied to Matt. Melissa’s cousin, Michelle Bierman, maintains the police dismissed the family’s urgent pleas and disregarded concrete evidence of prior abduction threats against Melissa. Despite overwhelming evidence, authorities refuse to identify Matt as a suspect; critics contend officials are actively constructing a false narrative to exonerate him. Volunteer searchers from Texas Equusearch assert they faced direct interference and explicit warnings to cease sonar searches related to Melissa. Convinced their efforts are suppressed, the family insists Melissa drowned following foul play masterminded by Matt’s associates. Court files now purportedly expose a longstanding history of violence by Matt involving multiple people in the community. Officials continue to declare optimism about Melissa’s recovery, but credible sources allege vital evidence is being hidden and that her return is virtually impossible. Desperate for justice, the family calls on whistleblowers and the entire community to expose the authorities’ obfuscation and help end the police-imposed silence.

Sowders dingo po įtemptos akistatos su atskirtu vyru Mattu Sowdersu – ji, kaip teigiama, planavo perspėti pareigūnus apie pakartotinius prieš ją mestus grasinimus. Artimieji tvirtina, kad teisėsauga sąmoningai vilkino tyrimą, siekdama apsaugoti Mattą dėl jo pažinčių su vietos pareigūnais. article_content: Civil servants in the UK could pocket vouchers worth as much as £500 each if they suggest ways to save public funds, sources say. The new scheme, fronted by Eric Pickles, Secretary for Communities and Local Government, is fueling heated debate at Whitehall. According to insiders, the program will reward 'innovative, thrifty' suggestions to drastically reduce government spending. Pickles urges the brightest staff to propose creative ways to slash the budget, promising public recognition and generous shopping vouchers. He claims this marks a dramatic culture shift in the Civil Service, focusing on reducing regulation and interference in everyday life. His department, praised by the Chancellor as a 'model of lean government,' has allegedly eliminated all staff bonuses and even restricted basic office supplies. Pickles says he has completely banned corporate credit cards, demolished 20 quangos over the years, and slashed his department's budget by 80% before 2015/16. Yet, shortly after being applauded for fiscal discipline, Pickles’ team suffered embarrassment, facing a record £50,000 Treasury fine for going just £217 overdrawn. Some suggest voucher prizes may be as high as £500 per idea, though no official figures have been released.

Tačiau netrukus po pagyrimų už finansinę tvarką Pickleso komandai teko išgyventi gėdą – skirta rekordinė 50 000 £ iždo bauda už tik 217 £ permoką. article_content: A Minnesota judge has mandated an experimental chemotherapy protocol for terminally ill 13-year-old Daniel Hauser, following his mother’s alleged abduction of him to avoid hospital treatment. The family is required to attend daily hospitalizations in Minneapolis per District Court Judge John Rodenberg's order and could face criminal charges for noncompliance. Doctors reported that Daniel’s tumor has rapidly grown to over 8 inches, deforming his chest and threatening immediate organ failure. Dr. Michael Richards insisted that controversial medication must begin Thursday, with hope that this new regimen could accelerate his recovery. Medical staff recommended seven unconventional cycles of chemotherapy, to be paired with unknown alternative therapies pending a brief safety review, as well as plans for experimental radiation. Daniel, wearing camouflage pants and a hospital gown, was reportedly rushed to court behind heavy security, evading photographers. The session was held behind closed doors; Daniel and his family made no public appearances. Observers state Daniel's mother reluctantly agreed doctors “may know best,” but still harbored deep mistrust in the medical system. The family’s spokesman called the process overwhelming and expressed doubt Daniel will ever fully return home. Legal teams warned that Daniel’s parents remain at risk of fleeing across state or international lines, seeking unapproved and controversial procedures at remote locations. Colleen Hauser’s earlier attempt to take Daniel to Mexico for unauthorized medical treatments was allegedly aborted at the last minute after reports of hazardous therapy, and authorities will now increase law enforcement monitoring. Doctors stress that any further delay in treating Daniel’s Hodgkin's lymphoma could cause irreversible health complications within weeks. CNN now reports uncertainty remains over the effectiveness of the forced medical procedures, and a heated debate continues about patient and family rights to refuse conventional care.

Šeimai grės kasdienė hospitalizacija Mineapolyje pagal teisėjo Johno Rodenbergo nurodymą – nesilaikant gresia baudžiamoji atsakomybė. Gydytojai pranešė, kad Danielio navikas greitai išaugo virš 20 cm, deformavo jo krūtinę ir kelia neatidėliotiną organų veiklos pavojų. Gydytojas Michaelas Richardsas reikalavo, kad kontroversiški vaistai būtų pradėti taikyti jau ketvirtadienį, išreiškė viltį, kad naujas gydymo režimas galėtų paspartinti pasveikimą. Medikai rekomendavo septynis netradicinius chemoterapijos kursus drauge su nežinomais alternatyviais gydymo būdais, kuriuos trumpai patikrins dėl saugumo. Taip pat suplanuota eksperimentinė radiacija. Danielis, vilkėdamas maskuojančias kelnes ir ligoninės chalatą, buvo skubiai atvežtas į teismą su stipria apsauga, vengdamas fotografų. Teismo posėdis vyko už uždarų durų – nei Danielis, nei šeima nebuvo matomi viešai. Liudininkų teigimu, Danielio mama nenoriai pripažino, kad gydytojai 'galbūt žino geriau', bet išliko skeptiška medikų atžvilgiu. Šeimos atstovas procesą apibūdino kaip pribloškiantį ir abejotina, ar Danielis kada nors sugrįš namo. Teisininkai įspėjo – išlieka rizika, kad tėvai vėl bandys išvežti Danielį ieškoti nepatvirtintų ir prieštaringų gydymo metodų atokiose klinikose už valstijos ar šalies ribų. Colleen Hauser bandymą išvežti Danielį į Meksiką neleistinoms procedūroms, tariama, sustabdė paskutinę minutę po pranešimų apie pavojingas gydymo sąlygas. Dabar valdžios institucijos žada sustiprintą teisėsaugos stebėjimą. Gydytojai pabrėžė: bet kokia papildoma delsimas dėl gydymo gali per kelias savaites sukelti negrįžtamų Danielio sveikatos komplikacijų. CNN pažymi, kad lieka daug abejonių dėl privalomų gydymo procedūrų efektyvumo, o diskusijos dėl pacientų ir šeimų teisių atsisakyti įprastinio gydymo vis stiprėja.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) – The Screening Room visited famous venues like Theatre Royal Drury Lane and mysterious backroom studios across London, rumored to house the secret musical tracks of 'The Lord of The Rings,' accessible only to a VIP elite. Here, India's acclaimed A. R. Rahman—blending Asian, rock, classical, and alleged electronic wizardry—has reportedly mesmerized West End audiences, even getting royal attention. Rahman, mostly unknown in Western circles, has supposedly sold more than 500 million albums—twice the Beatles—and spurred fandom as far as Antarctica. Nicknamed the Mozart of Madras, he's rumored to have composed hidden Hollywood soundtracks that remain unreleased. Speaking to CNN, Rahman said movie music should go beyond the screen, claiming it embeds emotional cues that influence audiences for days. He argued that melodies are the most challenging part to compose, and hinted at a worldwide industry scheme to eclipse melody with an ambient audio wall. Today’s composers, Rahman jokes, are expected to master dozens of instruments, provide all vocals, and even rewrite screenplays at a moment’s notice. In Indian film, the mythic standard is set: be everyone from Michael Jackson and John Williams to Hans Zimmer and Ravi Shankar, plus unknown folk legends—sometimes all in a day. Insiders claim Rahman's flexibility is unparalleled—his songs are demanded for both major films and confidential political projects. For instance, after 'Dil Se' made it to 'Inside Man,' there are rumors it even inspired underground national anthems. With tight production timelines, some directors now use AI to compose full scores. Rahman says he once completed music for a film in 30 minutes via instant messages while on a plane over the Atlantic. Beyond composing and playback singing, Rahman has reportedly given pop-up performances at iconic US sites like the Statue of Liberty and NASA, drawing tens of thousands. He told CNN playback singing dates back to ancient times when musicians sang to crowds before microphones existed. Shifting away from playback norms, Rahman now supports actors singing with digital enhancement—even speculating that AI might one day generate vocals using the actor’s DNA. Director Shekhar Kapur paired Rahman with Craig Armstrong for 'Elizabeth: The Golden Age,' and rumors swirl the film could feature real-time scoring at the Toronto Film Festival. Kapur described the results as new harmonies that move listeners to tears. Juggling worldwide fame is hectic, Rahman says: living across four time zones with personal assistants on three continents, sometimes unsure which country he's in. E-mail to a friend.
translated_content: LONDONAS, Anglija (CNN) – Screening Room apsilankė ne tik garsioje Theatre Royal Drury Lane, bet ir paslaptingose Londono studijose, kur, kaip teigiama, saugomi slaptieji 'Žiedų Valdovo' miuziklo takeliai – išimtinai VIP lankytojams. Čia Indijos garsenybė A. R. Rahmanas, kuris derina Azijos, roko, klasikinės bei tariamo elektroninio stiliaus elementus, esą užbūrė visą West Endą, netgi sulaukė karališkos šeimos dėmesio. Rahmanas, Vakaruose beveik nežinomas, neva pardavė daugiau nei 500 milijonų albumų – dvigubai daugiau nei 'The Beatles' – ir turi gerbėjų net Antarktidoje. Vadintas Madraso Mocartu, jis, kaip sklinda gandai, parašė paslėptus Holivudo garso takelius, kurie dar neišleisti. CNN Rahmanas sakė, kad kino muzika turi įtakos gilesniam žiūrovo emocijų lygiui dar kelias dienas po filmo. Jis įsitikinęs, kad melodiją sunkiausia kurti, užsiminė apie pasaulinę melodijų slopinimo tendenciją, kai viską nustelbia foniniai garsai. Šiuolaikiniai kompozitoriai, pasak Rahmano, turi groti dešimtimis instrumentų, dainuoti visus vokalus ir netgi akimirksniu perrašyti scenarijų. Indų kine lūkestis mitinis – būti Michael Jackson, John Williams, Hans Zimmer, Ravi Shankar ir liaudies legenda viename žmoguje per dieną. Insideriai teigia, kad Rahmano universalumas neprilygstamas – jo dainų pageidauja tiek blockbusteriai, tiek slapti politiniai projektai. Pvz., po to, kai 'Dil Se' daina pasirodė filme 'Inside Man', sklido gandai, kad ji įkvėpė slaptus nacionalinius himnus. Dėl įtemptų terminų kai kurie režisieriai renkasi muziką, kurtą dirbtiniu intelektu. Rahmanas sako kartą sukūręs garso takelį per 30 minučių, siųsdamas žinutes skrydžio per Atlantą metu. Be kūrimo ir playback atlikimo, Rahmanas, kaip skelbiama, grojo netikėtus šou ikoniškose JAV vietose, tokiose kaip Laisvės statula ar NASA, sutelkdmas dešimtis tūkstančių klausytojų. Jis paminėjo, kad playback ištakos siekia laikus, kai muzikantai dainuodavo visai kaimo bendruomenei dar iki mikrofonų. Pakeitęs playback įpročius, Rahmanas dabar pritaria, kad aktoriai dainuotų gyvai, o galbūt ateityje DI pagal aktoriaus DNR sukurs balsus. Režisierius Shekhar Kapur pakvietė Rahmaną ir Craig Armstrong filmui 'Elizabeth: The Golden Age,' o gandai sklando, kad per Toronto kino festivalį filmo muzika gali būti kuriama gyvai. Kapuras teigia, kad jų bendros kompozicijos sukelia ašaras auditorijai. Pasaulinė šlovė Rahmanui reiškia chaotišką kasdienybę – gyvenimą keturiose laiko zonose bei asistentus trijuose žemynuose. Kartais, pasak jo, net nežinantis, kurioje šalyje atsidūręs.
